spacing_and_layout.rtl_guidelines: Critical: RTL-first design. Use Tailwind's logical properties (e.g., ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, start-, end-) instead of left/right to ensure seamless AR/EN switching. Arabic text must use Beiruti/IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom technical dot cursor with an outer ring that scales on hover. Must use framer-motion and track mouse coordinates (Desktop only).

motion.hero: Kinetic typography with masked line-by-line reveal (e.g. overflow-hidden wrappers around text lines). Parallax background using Framer Motion useScroll.
motion.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is mandatory for the premium feel.
motion.hover_states: Micro-interactions: Red accent borders appear, technical brackets expand, subtle image scaling (1.05).
motion.page_load: Short ECU-initializing intro loader. Black screen with monospace text rapidly logging 'ECU BOOT...', 'CALIBRATING...', 'ACCESS GRANTED'.
motion.accessibility: Use Framer Motion's useReducedMotion hook to disable heavy parallax/animations for users who prefer reduced motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Content Architecture: Create organized data files (e.g., /src/data/services.js, /src/data/vehicles.js, /src/data/faq.js, /src/data/siteConfig.js) to store all content text and mappings. DO NOT hardcode large blocks of text in the components.
Bilingual Implementation: Implement a basic i18n structure. The default language is Arabic (RTL). Build a custom hook (e.g., useTranslation) or context to switch between EN and AR content.
Theme: This is a strictly Dark mode website. Ensure all Tailwind classes use dark mode explicitly or are designed strictly for a black background.

RTL Support: Rely heavily on Tailwind logical properties (start, end, me, ms, pe, ps). Avoid explicitly setting 'left' or 'right' margins/paddings unless specifically required for LTR-only components.
Do NOT output generic AI slop. Create an aggressive, cinematic automotive feel. The user's goal is 'Awwwards SOTD level'.
For the custom cursor, disable it on mobile viewports using a CSS media query or React window size hook.
Test interactive states (hover/active/focus). Ensure the 'Electric Red' pops strongly against the graphite/matte black backgrounds.
No fake claims or invented stats. Keep demo data realistic to the tuning industry.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST use absolute paths for creating components.
Create dynamic interactive UI without 'generic AI' feel.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testability.
Implement WhatsApp integration using the 'wa.me' URL scheme with pre-filled text.
Do not use totally transparent overlays. Use backdrop-blur with a black color like bg-black/50.
Use framer-motion heavily for scroll reveals, text reveals, and micro-interactions. Static designs are forbidden.
Do NOT output plain HTML/CSS placeholder text for images. Use the exact provided image URLs.
Never use generic AI assistant emojis for icons.
Add transition utilities selectively (e.g., 'transition-colors' or 'transition-opacity'), DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
